dog.description_text:
Since I'm a long stay pup, my adoption fee has been reduced! Visit me today to find out my favorite treats and how you can take me home!

My foster writes: Hakuna Matata! I'm Simba, and while I've spent some time exploring the Pride Lands, I've decided my true kingdom is wherever my humans are.
My dream role? Royal Work-From-Home Companion. I excel at supervising Zoom meetings from a cozy nap spot, providing couch snuggles on demand, and conducting important squeaky-toy inspections during coffee breaks. If you're looking for a loyal member of your pride, I'm your guy.
When I venture beyond Pride Rock, I enjoy greeting humans with a friendly sniff and saving my best kisses for my favorite people. I'm more Rafiki than wildebeest stampede-I prefer calm, peaceful surroundings so I can sleep all day. Sometimes, when I see other dogs that want to play with me, I feel compelled to give them my best lion impression so they know I'd love to play. What can I say? A future king has to make his presence known!

My foster writes:
Hi, I'm Simba, and my favorite place in the world is being by your side. My dream job is a full-time work-from-home coworker, and I take my duties very seriously: napping next to your desk, snuggling next to you on the couch, and proudly squeaking my toys during breaks.
When we're out and about, I love sniffing humans and licking my favorite ones. I'm more of a calm-vibes kind of guy and would love a quieter home (as I am still learning that many humans can live on apartment floors). Sometimes I feel that other dogs on walks want to hear my voice and see me jump so they know I want to play with them.Humans say I am a smarty-paws as I'm crate-trained, already know tricks (sit, down, and paw), and think that bathrooms belong outside. Now all I need is my forever humans. Could that be you?

Searching for a loyal sidekick who never misses a bathroom trip? This sweet boy is happiest being near you and would excel in his dream career as a full-time work-from-home coworker. He is always down to nap next to your desk, snuggle next to you on the couch, or chew on his squeaky toys. Outside, he's friendly with people and incredibly attentive. He thrives in calm. quieter surroundings without too much hustle and bustle and is looking for walks in low dog areas. Simba is also a total smarty-paws, crate-trained and has mastered "sit," "down," and "paw." If you're ready to meet a gentle soul, Simba's your guy!

What my friends at ACC say about me:

My history is a mystery and my friends here do not know much about me yet!

I would appreciate slow introductions to new people and places to help me feel safe.

I love getting pets and - you guessed it - snuggles!

I would do best in a home without very tiny humans, although I could be open to older human children once I meet them.

I am excitable and energetic! I will need positive outlets for my energy!
dog.name: Simba
